Description: Determines if you should be rewarded with a bonus for your current speed passing through a checkpoint.

Description: The bonus rewarded for perfoming a homing chain.

Description: The limit the homing chain bonus should be clamped to after being multiplied.
Set this to 0 to disable it.

Elements.Name: SlamBonus
Description: The bonus rewarded for crashing through enemies rapidly.

Description: The limit the slam bonus should be clamped to after being multiplied.
Set this to 0 to disable it.

Elements.Name: TrickBonusLimit
Description: The limit the trick bonus should be clamped to after being multiplied.
Set this to 0 to disable it.

Elements.Name: TimeBonusExpression
Description: The Lua expression that calculates the time bonus.
Exposed variables:
• TotalRingCount - total number of rings obtained by the player.
• TotalEnemies - total number of enemies destroyed by the player.
• TotalPhysics - total number of physics objects destroyed by the player.
• TotalPointMarkers - total number of checkpoints passed by the player.
• TotalRedRings - total number of red rings obtained by the player.
• TotalRainbowRings - total number of rainbow rings passed by the player.
• TotalItemBoxes - total number of item boxes obtained by the player.
• TotalSuperRings - total number of super rings obtained by the player.
• TotalTricks - total number of tricks performed by the player.
• TotalDashRings - total number of dash rings passed by the player.
• TotalQuickSteps - total number of quick steps performed by the player.
• TotalDrifts - total number of drifts performed by the player.
• TotalBalloons - total number of balloons destroyed by the player.
• TotalSpeed - total speed built up throughout the stage when passing checkpoints.
• HighestSpeed - the highest speed recorded when passing through a checkpoint.
• RingCount - number of rings the player finished with.
• Minutes - minutes on the timer.
• Seconds - seconds on the timer.
• ElapsedTime - total amount of time passed in seconds.
• Score - total score the player finished with.
• MaxScore - the maximum amount of score the player can obtain.
• MinSeconds - elapsed time in seconds the player must finish below for a higher time bonus.
• MaxSeconds - elapsed time in seconds the player must finish below for a time bonus.
• StageID - the current stage ID.
Set this to '0' to disable it.

Elements.Name: HomingChainMultiplier
Description: The multiplier used to increase the homing chain bonus.

Description: The multiplier used to increase the speed bonus.

Description: The multiplier used to increase the slam bonus.

Description: The multiplier used to increase the trick bonus.

Elements.Name: IsScoreTimeout
Description: Determines if the score should stop counting up after you surpass the maximum amount of time for a time bonus.

Elements.Name: SuperSonicTimer
Description: The amount of time in seconds the player is rewarded for being Super Sonic.

Elements.Name: SlamTimer
Description: The amount of time in seconds the slam bonus times out after when the player is grounded.

Elements.Name: IsRestoreLastCheckpointScore
Description: Determines if the score should reset back to what you had at your last checkpoint upon dying.

Elements.Name: MaxScore
Description: The maximum amount of score the player can obtain.

Elements.Name: PerfectBonusType
Description: The behaviour of the perfect bonus for calculating your final rank.

Elements.Name: ScoreFormat
Description: The string format used to display the score on the HUD.
Examples:
%d - write the raw value.
%06d - write the value with six digit padding.

Elements.Name: IsCustomUI
Description: Disables Score Generations' HUD in favour of using a custom layout from another mod.

Elements.Name: ProhibitedStages
Description: The list of stages that don't display or count your score.
Elements.DefaultValue: bms, bms001, bde, bde001, bsd, bsd001, bpc, bpc001, bsl, bsl001, bne, bne001, blb, blb001

Description: Disable perfect bonus.
